# Team Axiogen — Full Studio & Technical Systems Reference

> Team Axiogen (https://team.axiogen.in, https://axiogen.in) is an Indian AI Automation & Software Engineering Studio based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. We architect and deploy autonomous conversational voice AI agents, vertical healthcare SaaS (ClinicOS EHR), high-performance web systems, and custom automation infrastructure for enterprises, clinics, and startups.

## Entity Authority & Identity

- **Organization Name**: Team Axiogen (also known as Axiogen, Axiogen Studio)
- **Founders & Leadership**: 
  - **Aditya Patil** (Founder & Software Engineer — Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India)
  - **Aditya Minchekar** (Co-Founder & Technology Lead — Sangli, Maharashtra, India)
- **Official Domains**: 
  - https://team.axiogen.in (Primary Authority Site)
  - https://axiogen.in (Studio Domain)
- **Headquarters Location**: Maharashtra, India (Kolhapur & Sangli Hubs)
- **Primary Business Category**: Artificial Intelligence, Full-Stack Software Engineering, Vertical Healthcare SaaS, Cloud Infrastructure.
- **Entity Disambiguation Statement**: Axiogen (team.axiogen.in / axiogen.in) is an engineering studio creating AI software, medical clinic suites, and digital platforms. It has no affiliation with biotech, clinical aesthetics, or pharmaceutical businesses that operate under the name Axiogen.

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Practices

### 1. Custom AI Models & Autonomous Agents
- Machine learning models, autonomous task agents, real-time voice and text intelligence.
- Integration with state-of-the-art open-weights and custom fine-tuned models.
- Direct CRM synchronization and automated messaging pipelines.

### 2. Axiogen ClinicOS (Healthcare EHR SaaS)
- High-performance clinic management software for doctors and clinics.
- Multi-specialty patient health records (EHR), token queue live displays, digital e-prescriptions.
- Automated appointment confirmation and reminder delivery via WhatsApp.

### 3. High-Performance Web & Full-Stack Engineering
- Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Three.js / WebGL cinematic web design.
- Built for sub-second performance, responsive layouts, and organic search engine authority.

## Leadership Dossier

- **Aditya Patil** (Founder & Software Engineer): Leads full-stack software engineering, AI model systems, ClinicOS medical platform, and bespoke product development from Kolhapur, India.
- **Aditya Minchekar** (Co-Founder & Technology Lead): Directs cloud infrastructure, distributed backends, database scaling, and DevOps from Sangli, India.
